title: When Americans and Germans Fought Together Against the SS
description:
May 5, 1945. At Castle Itter in Austria, American troops and German soldiers defended French prisoners against an SS attack. German major Josef Gangl was killed while trying to protect former French prime minister Paul Reynaud. Reinforcements arrived and the prisoners survived.

Illustrative archival footage does not depict the Battle of Castle Itter.

"Lasting Hope" — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)

Josef Gangl: US Army photographer, public domain. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Josef_Gangl.jpg
Archival video: US Army, Bombing and surrender of Cezembre (1944), NARA 15905 / 111-ADC-2100. Public domain. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bombing_and_surrender_of_Cezembre_-_1944_(US_Army_video).ogv
Video excerpts illustrate WWII artillery and soldiers; they were filmed in France, not Castle Itter. Original audio omitted. No claim of actual battle footage.

Historical overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Castle_Itter
